memories.text: When the user practises Dutch, answer in simple Dutch first and add an English translation underneath; correct mistakes gently.
Chose a twice-weekly conversation class over the app because speaking was the weak point.
The user's online chess rating is about 1650 and they prefer slow time controls.
When analysing chess games, focus on the opening mistakes first and explain the plan behind each move.
The camera is a mirrorless body with a 35 mm prime lens; shoot RAW and keep the ISO under 3200.
Process photos: import RAW files, cull to the best 10%, adjust exposure and white balance, export as JPEG at 2048 pixels.
Suggest books by translated fiction authors and avoid thrillers; the user reads about 20 pages every evening.
On 2026-10-10 the user played at the open mic for the first time and plans to play again in spring.
For Friday film night pick films under two hours with subtitles that both Alex and the user have not seen.
The tax declaration was late because the employer statement arrived in March; ask for it in January.
